text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from NT$104,289 to NT$94,724, but this decline alone does not predict what prices will do next.","The ups and downs reinforce that I should judge risk and diversification against my plan, not make reactive trades to ease the discomfort of losses.","Doing nothing has avoided impulsive decisions so far; I should continue to trade infrequently, but review whether my holdings still fit my goals."]}
